premises.text: A cloud-based phone system replaces legacy desk phone hardware with software
premises.evidence_span: Airco is a cloud-based phone system that replaces really the legacy phone system

premises.text: The system connects with CRM, help desk, BI, and other business tools so customer conversations stay recorded in the tools companies already use
premises.evidence_span: Airco connects with all the tools companies are using

premises.text: The phone system is simple enough that anyone can set it up anywhere and talk to customers
premises.evidence_span: Airco is simple to set up, can be set up by anyone in the world

premises.text: An integrations marketplace lets Airco and partners build dozens of integrations on top of the phone system
premises.evidence_span: the first phone system in the world creating their marketplace. We have now created more than 50 integrations

premises.text: Recording and unifying conversation data across tools lets teams know the customer and improve daily work
premises.evidence_span: having you be able to know your customer, record all the conversation, and be able to improve your daily work

value.text: Businesses can run customer conversations on a modern phone system that keeps context in their existing tools
value.evidence_span: serving 4,000 businesses with their phone system every day to make them work with their customers

causal_links.evidence_span: We replace that. We make it a software
we are creating an ecosystem for voice
